# Proxy Test

The Apify actor [`apify/proxy-test`](https://apify.com/apify/proxy-test) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its default build **0.0.4** (module version **0.1.0**). Runs use whatever build the actor has as default when they start, so they keep working as Apify retires old builds; the input types below are refreshed weekly and can lag an actor that changed its input since.

This actor simply tests given array of URLs against selected proxy URLs or Apify proxy groups.

## Pricing

Free — you pay only for the Apify platform usage (compute units) of the run.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/proxy-test) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-proxy-test@0.1.0#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      testUrls: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `testUrls` | array | yes |  | Test URLs — Enter URLs on which you want test to be performed |
| `proxy` | object | yes |  | Proxy configuration — Select apify proxy groups or custom proxies you want to test |
| `timeoutSecs` | integer |  | `120` | Timeout — Timeout for page.goto() or request in seconds |
| `plainHttpRequest` | boolean |  | `false` | Use plain HTTP request — If checked then simple HTTP request will be send instead of full Chrome browser. |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
